status: launched 2026-10-19 on Kaggle (kernel version 1); results pending
dataset_version: v3: 6,000-question pool (4,000 MedQA train, 2,000 MedMCQA train) and 600-question dev split, decontaminated against all four benchmarks, data fingerprint f102ed1e8991077c (data/v3/data_report.json)
hypothesis: Fine-tuning on the base model's own gold-verified reasoning keeps its native thinking (length within about 20% of the base) and does not lose accuracy, unlike run 3's foreign traces. Success: E2 >= base on dev_medqa thinking-mode accuracy (paired), with median thinking within 20% of the base. Failure: E2 below the base on dev, or thinking that collapses as in run 3.

training.data: base model's own completions on the pool: 2 samples per question at a 4,096-token budget; kept only if closed, unforced, and on the gold letter; one random kept sample per question; 20% answer-only rows

evaluation.protocol: E2: thinking budget 3,072, seed 1234, Qwen thinking sampling; dev split (300 MedQA + 300 MedMCQA train questions) for selection; benchmarks reported, not tuned on. Engine: vLLM if its smoke test passed in the session, transformers otherwise (recorded in each meta.json).

notes: Training stops by a time guard (at most 4 h); if it stops before the end of the epoch, the cosine schedule is cut short. Gold-letter filtering cannot catch right answers reached by wrong reasoning.
